name: CreateDeploySuccess
title: Blocks/Create/CreateDeploySuccess
summary: The outcome screen a create flow ends on, in the terminal column of the wizard page: a heading with its lead and, for a Git source, the scope as a Tag; the deployment card with the service name with a Live Tag and its creation time, Visit site, the domain with Add custom domain, and the repository with its branch; the Resources list that tags each row Created or Bound; Next steps as `IntegrationCard`s that open the docs or carry on in the console; Get started with the CLI or GitHub Actions for a resource made from the CLI; and the Manage service button (Manage resource when nothing serves it yet). Any create flow can end on it, with its own title and, when there is no Git source, no scope. Built from `Card`, `IntegrationCard`, `Tag`, `Button`, `Link`, `Tooltip`, `Item`, `ToggleGroup` and `CodeBlock`.

variants.name: CliCreated
variants.summary: A resource made from the CLI that nothing serves yet: no deployment card, the resource as the only row, next steps that deploy it here (Recommended) or on a new service, and Get started with the CLI and GitHub Actions paths.
